newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products start steady to firm with futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products start steady to firm with futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were steady to slightly firmer in quiet early trade on Friday but traders said small gains were mainly on the back of firmer crude and product futures.
Gas oil edged around 50 cents higher matching gains in benchmark gas oil futures as premiums for 0.2 sulphur product held steady. Prompt lifting barges were offered at July IPE evens fob Rotterdam.
Premiums for diesel barges weakened under the pressure of lengthy supplies and slack demand. Prompt liftings were offered around $1 lower at July IPE +$5 fob ARA.

Despite a closed trans-Atlantic arbitrage and growing supplies, firmer crude and NYMEX unleaded gasoline held ARA gasoline prices steady although traders said discussion was thin. Eurograde valued notionally around $187 with regular around $180 fob ARA.
High sulphur fuel oil barges were unchanged at $81/$82 fob ARA.
